name: Securities Settlement Transaction Confirmation V 13
definition: Scope|An account servicer sends a SecuritiesSettlementTransactionConfirmation to an account owner to confirm the partial or full delivery or receipt of financial instruments, free or against of payment, physically or by book-entry.|The account servicer/owner relationship may be:|- a central securities depository or another settlement market infrastructure acting on behalf of their participants|- an agent (sub-custodian) acting on behalf of their global custodian customer, or|- a custodian acting on behalf of an investment management institution or a broker/dealer.||Usage|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent,|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information,|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information using the relevant elements in the Business Application Header.

TransactionIdentificationDetails.name: Transaction Identification Details
TransactionIdentificationDetails.definition: Provides transaction type and identification information.

Linkages.name: Linkages
Linkages.definition: Link to another transaction - provided for information only.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Financial instrument representing a sum of rights of the investor vis-a-vis the issuer.

QuantityAndAccountDetails.name: Quantity And Account Details
QuantityAndAccountDetails.definition: Details related to the account and quantity involved in the transaction.

SettlementParameters.name: Settlement Parameters
SettlementParameters.definition: Parameters which explicitly state the conditions that must be fulfilled before a particular transaction of a financial instrument can be settled. These parameters are defined by the instructing party in compliance with settlement rules in the market the transaction will settle in.

StandingSettlementInstructionDetails.name: Standing Settlement Instruction Details
StandingSettlementInstructionDetails.definition: Settlement standing instruction database to be used to derive the settlement parties involved in the transaction.

DeliveringSettlementParties.name: Delivering Settlement Parties
DeliveringSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of delivering settlement parties.

ReceivingSettlementParties.name: Receiving Settlement Parties
ReceivingSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of receiving settlement parties.

CashParties.name: Cash Parties
CashParties.definition: Cash parties involved in the transaction if different from the securities settlement parties.

SettledAmount.name: Settled Amount
SettledAmount.definition: Amount effectively settled and which will be credited to/debited from the account owner's cash account. It may differ from the instructed settlement amount based on market tolerance level.

OtherAmounts.name: Other Amounts
OtherAmounts.definition: Other amounts than the settlement amount.

DigitalPaymentSettlement.name: Digital Payment Settlement
DigitalPaymentSettlement.definition: Total quantity  of digital asset to be paid or received in exchange for the securities token; or the network fee.

OtherBusinessParties.name: Other Business Parties
OtherBusinessParties.definition: Other business parties relevant to the transaction.

AdditionalPhysicalOrRegistrationDetails.name: Additional Physical Or Registration Details
AdditionalPhysicalOrRegistrationDetails.definition: Information for registration or physical settlement.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

SettledAmountRule.definition: If the instruction is against payment, then SettledAmount must be present.

ReceivingDepositoryAndParty1Rule.definition: If the instruction is a delivery and no standing settlement instruction applies, then ReceivingDepository and Party1 must be present.

DeliveringDepositoryAndParty1Rule.definition: If the instruction is a receive and no standing settlement instruction applies, then DeliveringDepository and Party1 must be present.

SellerSSIRule.definition: If standing settlement instruction applies and the instruction is a receipt, then Seller must be present.

BuyerSSIRule.definition: If standing settlement instruction applies and the instruction is a delivery, then Buyer must be present.

SecuritiesMarketPracticeGroupGuideline.definition: The Securities Market Practice Group (SMPG) has published market practice recommendations on the use of this message.|These market practices are available on www.smpg.info.

TwoLegTransactionOpeningClosing2Rule.definition: For settlement of two part transactions (buy-sell back, sell buy-back, collateral in and out), the opening/initiation and closing/return of the transaction is confirmed by sending the following combination of TransactionIdentificationDetails/SecuritiesMovementType codes and SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType codes:||Sell-Buy Back: Sell|TransactionIdentificationDetails/SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: SellBuyBack (SBBK)|Sell-Buy Back: Buy Back|TransactionIdentificationDetails/SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: SellBuyBack (SBBK)||Buy-Sell Back: Buy|TransactionIdentificationDetails/SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: BuySellBack (BSBK)|Buy-Sell Back: Sell Back|TransactionIdentificationDetails/SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI) |SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: BuySellBack (BSBK)||Collateral (giver) Out Initiation|TransactionIdentificationDetails/SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: CollateralOut (COLO)|Collateral (giver) Out Return|TransactionIdentificationDetails/SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: CollateralOut (COLO)||Collateral (taker) In Initiation|TransactionIdentificationDetails/SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: CollateralIn (COLI)|Collateral (taker) In Return|TransactionIdentificationDetails/SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI) |SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: CollateralIn (COLI).
